_about: Public-domain Amy Wilson-Carmichael (1867-1951, missionary at Dohnavur, South India) for the Word Hoard: Things as They Are (1903), Overweights of Joy (1906), Lotus Buds (1910), Walker of Tinnevelly (1916), Mimosa (second edition, 1925) and Raj, Brigand Chief (1927), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 33 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

carmichael-things-as-they-are: Things as They Are: Mission Work in Southern India (London: Morgan and Scott, 1903)
carmichael-overweights-of-joy: Overweights of Joy (London: Morgan and Scott, 1906)
carmichael-lotus-buds: Lotus Buds (London: Morgan and Scott, MCMX)
carmichael-walker-tinnevelly: Walker of Tinnevelly (London: Morgan and Scott, MCMXVI)
carmichael-mimosa: Mimosa, Who Was Charmed, second edition (Madras: S.P.C.K. Depot, 1925)

_alternates.carmichael-pg: PG 29426 (Things as They Are, 1905) and PG 29427 (Lotus Buds, 1912)
_alternates.carmichael-copies: Later reprints; Ragland (1922), Ponnammal (1918) and other titles not read

_excluded.carmichael-later: 1930 printings of Raj and Mimosa; all post-1930 titles
